title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Included Miles and the Excess Rate per Mile
content:
Mileage on the Car Rental Rate Classes is published as three amounts for each class: the miles included in the rate for each rental day, whether the class carries unlimited mileage, and the charge for each mile driven beyond the included allowance.

| Rate class | Included miles per day | Unlimited mileage | Excess rate per mile (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 125 | no | 0.32 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 175 | no | 0.29 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 200 | no | 0.25 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 0 | yes | 0.00 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 0 | yes | 0.00 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 250 | no | 0.22 |

Where the class carries unlimited mileage, the included miles per day are published as 0 and the excess rate per mile as 0, because the class includes every mile driven rather than a counted allowance. The Inclusive Flex Rate and the Premium Inclusive Rate are the two such classes.

**Basis questions the schedule answers.**

*What are the included miles on the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate?* 250 miles for each rental day, at an excess rate of 0.22 per mile beyond the allowance.

*Which class carries the smallest counted allowance?* The Pay Now Saver Rate, at 125 miles for each rental day, and it also carries the dearest excess rate at 0.32 per mile. The Pay Now Standard Rate carries 175 miles a day at 0.29 per mile, and the Pay At Counter Flex Rate 200 miles a day at 0.25 per mile.

*What does the excess rate mean on a class marked unlimited?* Nothing falls due under it: the class allows every mile driven, so its published excess rate is 0.
